title: Quotient reduction of the diagonal class pullback square
statement: Fix prime l, g:Yprime→Y between Noetherian schemes, E, pi and n. Let d0,d0prime be integral diagrams with the specified integral PullbackCompatibility and let d,dprime be quotient diagrams supplied with ScalarCompatibility from d0,d0prime. For maps mP,mW satisfying QuotientPullMap and any normalized quotient SourcePullback s, the derived pullback of d.delta followed by s.endpoints.lineW.shift equals the canonical single pullback, followed by s.supported and dprime.delta. No quotient trace square or exchange invertibility is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the scalar/pullback natural transformation as the scalar adjunction mate of the exact restriction/pullback comparison. Apply quotient line normalization on the shifted integral line and supported-source normalization on the degree-zero source. These identities involve no diagonal class.

The private diagonal_scalar_paste_generic instantiates the categorical argument with abstract coefficient rings before the final concrete specialization. Its private scalar_pullback_paste uses naturality on the integral class arrow, integral.delta, scalar.delta and scalarprime.delta. Explicit associativity rewrites identify composite source isomorphisms. The source identity identifies the precomposition map, after the quotient supported isomorphism, with a composite of two isomorphisms; hence that precomposition is invertible and can be cancelled. The resulting equality is exactly ClassPullbackSquare.comm.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalQuotient_classPullback
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Y']
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E) (n : ℕ)
    (d₀ : Diagram (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E))
    (d₀' : Diagram (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) Y'
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E))
    (integral : PullbackCompatibility (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) g
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) d₀ d₀'
      (spIntegralComparison (baseP g) l E) (spIntegralComparison (baseW g) l E))
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y (quotientLine l E π n))
    (d' : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y' (quotientLine l E π n))
    (scalar : ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) d₀ d)
    (scalar' : ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y'
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) d₀' d')
    (mP : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseP g)).obj
      (quotientLine l E π n (ProjectiveLine Y)).X ⟶
        (quotientLine l E π n (ProjectiveLine Y')).X)
    (mW : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseW g)).obj
      (quotientLine l E π n (diagonalSurface Y)).X ⟶
        (quotientLine l E π n (diagonalSurface Y')).X)
    (_hP : QuotientPullMap l E π n (baseP g) mP)
    (_hW : QuotientPullMap l E π n (baseW g) mW)
    (s : SourcePullback
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n)) g
      (quotientLine l E π n) mP mW) :
    ClassPullbackSquare
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n)) g
      (quotientLine l E π n) d d' mP mW s
